sources.guidance: Check the exact dependency/version and SDK owner guidance. Distinguish an outdated-version warning from a policy violation or critical issue. Do not invent the affected library.

Google documents a declaration deadline of February 1, 2027. Review Manage account, Account details, About you; declaration must reflect the owner's actual circumstances. Never choose or submit status automatically.

Check applicable changes and separate deadlines. For API 37+ consider local-network and location declaration requirements only when the actual manifest/features use those capabilities; do not infer violations from the target SDK alone.
